api.inspectSavedRecovery: inspectSavedRecovery(expectedOperation,expectedTxHash) -> frozen {status:empty|resumable|pending|canonical|unknown,operation,txHash}. Authenticates exact retained bytes/hash/op. Dropped requires valid isValidTx and second matching dropped receipt; strict predecessors must still be missing-anchor invalid. No permit, acknowledge, write or send.
api.recover: recover({expectedOperation,expectedTxHash,beforeSubmit?}) optional bound options; exact own data captured before first await, callback receives only current hash. No-arg behavior retained with mandatory safety repairs. No signing/proof/fee generation. Callback is a trusted app capability, not a user-supplied function.
api.reconcilePrevious: Same optional binding; existing return {receipt,operation} and empty null semantics retained.
api.sendBoundary: After dropped+valid classification, re-read receipt; pending/canonical transitions do not resend. For actual resend, context guard, optional app callback, persisted strict predecessor guard, authenticated ciphertext read, context guard, second ciphertext read, final context guard then identical-byte submission. Caller holds exclusive account lease throughout.
api.timeout: Inspection has bounded reads and active flag to prevent timed-out initial SDK result from spawning further validation reads; current pending SDK call cannot be cancelled.

verification.cleanup: test process exited; no services/heavy jobs
verification.beforeFix: Both recover/reconcilePrevious first-attempt storage-mutation and last-read account-lock regressions failed before source repair.
coverage: Read-only exact inspection allstatuses/cipher equality/no acknowledgment
Exact bytes single broadcast then canonical repeat read-only
Wrong operation/hash, malformed/accessor options, mutable options captured, callback error preserved
Reinclusion between validity and second receipt no resend

App original/replacement head/marker/fee attribution and explicit UI consent still require subsequent source wiring/review.
